text: Murdeshwar or Murudeshwara is a town in Uttara Kannada district in the state of Karnataka, India, and lies on the coast of the Arabian Sea. It contains the world's third tallest Shiva statue, as well as the Murudeshwara Temple. The town has a railway station on the Mangalore–Mumbai Konkan railway route.
best_time: November to February (pleasant sunny days, gentle ocean breezes, calm swimming waters)
